blocks.content: Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App
Here's what changed from the previous lesson:

items: We added the currentPage state added to App. It tracks which page the user is on, starting at 1.
pagedEntries replaces filteredEntries as what gets rendered. It is a useMemo() slice of filteredEntries.
handleQueryChange() wraps setQuery() and resets currentPage to 1 whenever the search changes.
We added the Previous and Next buttons below the entry list, with boundary checks to prevent going out of range.
